head: adfefc0cd53e9e49c0056afe0c0208dc4992dd63
scope: New UnifiedHistory lifecycle fence compatibility with existing browser error, completion-event, retry and voice paths
reviewedPaths: An initial or later thread/history rejection becomes conversation.error and clears loading without mutating or replaying a turn.
The error-banner retry button has no ready/activity/busy disable gate and starts history again without an old cursor while refreshing thread/session.
A matching turn/completed notification refreshes history automatically; generation and abort ownership reject late callbacks from the preceding traversal.
During voice, ordinary refresh intentionally does nothing, while the explicit recheck control remains available and voice close triggers refresh.
evidence: web/hooks/useConversation.ts:124-158 effect resets traversal and cursor
limitations: Static code review only; no test or browser execution in this task.
No claim of a fresh complete web audit; this verifies only compatibility with the proposed lifecycle fence.
Runtime source fix and its regression tests remain owned by runtime agent and will receive a separate independent diff review.
